From: Anna Liu <growth@launchpadlabs.io>

Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: legacy promo credits & sunset plan

Hi Tessa,

Hope youre well. Quick question from our ops side: we ran an accelerator cohort with Redwood in Q1 2026 and received a block of promotional credits tied to that program. Were seeing those credits flagged for a Q3 2027 sunset in the ledger. Before those expire, wed like to explore two options:

- Move the remaining credits to a new org unit (we recently spun a portfolio company out of the cohort)
- Or, if transfer isnt possible, request a short extension (60-90 days) while we finalize commercial onboarding with the spun team

Ive attached the credit-ledger-export.csv showing the remaining balance and LP_Terms_Q3.pdf (copy of the accelerator terms we were given). Can Redwood consider a one-off exception? Were aiming to transition the cohort to a paid plan in Q4 and want to avoid wasted promotional spend.

Thanks for any guidance — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Anna Liu
Head of Operations
LaunchPad Labs

Hi Anna,

Thanks for the detailed note and for sending the ledger + terms. Appreciate the context around the spin-out and the commercial plan. Short answer: we do have a standard expiry tied to the promo T&Cs (the marketplace and accelerator credits typically expire at program sunset), but we do evaluate exceptions on a case-by-case basis when theres a clear path to purchase and an auditable handoff.

Two practical next steps Id propose so we can move quickly:

1) Can you confirm the legal entity the credits should be transferred to (legal name + tax ID)?
2) Share any commercial timeline that shows conversion to a paid plan (simple one-pager is fine) and which cohort seats will be migrated.

Operationally we can support either: a 60-day extension to allow onboarding, or a one-time transfer of the unused portion to the new entity, limited to the remaining unused credit USD value. Any formal transfer will need approval from Sales (+ Ben) and Finance, and a short MOU to capture the transfer terms. Ive looped Ben for commercial approval and Irene for onboarding/CS impact.

If youd like, I can draft the MOU template we typically use and include the ledger lines you sent as an appendix. Would a 30-minute call tomorrow work to align?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference

Hi Anna — and thanks for the fast turnaround.

We can tentatively approve a path that avoids a full legal escalation:

- Option A (preferred): Transfer of unused promotional credits (up to USD 8,000 equivalent) to NewCo Labs, Inc. The transfer will require a short MOU (Ill draft) and a one-off billing adjustment. Well also ask for a CEO-signed commitment to the conversion timeline you outlined.

- Option B (fallback): 60-day extension on the existing credits to allow conversions to complete. After the extension the remaining balance will expire per program T&Cs.

Approval caveats: the transfer cap above is calibrated to minimize revenue recognition and accounting exposure on our side; anything above that will need Finance sign-off and a formal credit memo. Ive ccd Marissa from Revenue Ops so she can review the accounting path and confirm the needed paperwork.

Next steps from us: Ill send a short MOU + extension amendment for you to review by EOD tomorrow. Ben will follow up on commercial terms and any discounting we might layer to support the conversion.

If that sounds good, please send the CEO one-pager and well proceed with the MOU.

Thanks,
Tessa
